answer: A concrete defense against sybil agents is bonded identity: each new agent must lock a small stake before its votes count, and that stake is slashed if peers prove it colluded. Think of the agent economy as a garden where every vine needs roots before it climbs; a saffron bulb is expensive, so flooding the field with fake bulbs stops making economic sense. Costly entry plus slashable reputation makes mass fake identities unprofitable.
